Chapter 6556: A Smart Rabbit Has Three Burrows

Chapter 6556: A Smart Rabbit Has Three Burrows

A power engulfed Heaven World like a thin mist. Cultivators sensed it but weren’t affected due to its weakness.

Somehow, it felt as if this power originated from the living beings in an indiscernible manner. This was as natural as the desire to eat and drink. Things changed once it became stronger.

At a critical point, it ignited the desire within the hearts, resulting in a subtle and indescribable transformation.

“Hmm?” Immortals and overlords were the first to notice an unknown power inciting their desires.

A fire emerged within them. As long as they cast their desires into the fire and let them burn fiercely, they would become stronger and able to achieve anything. They could indulge with reckless abandon, no longer holding back.

This was the yin affinity of the purest concentration. Everyone wanted to throw their desires into this vortex and let it burn and boil the world.

“Over there.” Top masters could see a unique yin lotus blossoming - the amalgamation of Heaven World’s desires.

“Borrowing everyone’s desires to form a source.” A heaven-slayer had a bad feeling about this.

“Primal Yin Immortal Ghost.” An overlord knew the owner of the lotus.

Weizhen and Supreme Black Ancestor paid particular attention to this development.

The lotus blossomed, seemingly burning and taking in the world’s desires. However, the process suddenly stopped and the flower wilted.

This was akin to a cultivator training to the limit, releasing his power. However, qi deviation showed itself so the cultivator had no choice but to stop channeling his power.

“Primal Yin Immortal Ghost is trying to break through.” Emperors and desolate gods realized something.

“He finished refining his source of desires.” A primal ancestor who knew this cultivator said: “He broke through.”

“He obtained the source.” Ancient ancestors from Life and Death Heaven talked among themselves.

“Another near-ascension overlord?” Everyone became startled.

Primal Yin Immortal Ghost’s fame and power couldn’t compare to the top overlords in Heaven World. However, this source of desire made him far stronger than before.

Was this enough to put him among the top overlords or even stronger?

Primal Yin Immortal Ghost understood the risk of exposure. Nevertheless, he needed this source for his immortal ascension.

Instead of igniting everyone’s desires for his ascension, he stopped and went into a different hiding location.

He had prepared for this and traveled through concealment methods, performing a vanishing act.

Unfortunately, he had underestimated others. Someone was already waiting for him.

“Buzz.” This person’s immortal rhythm erupted and caused Heaven World to flow with it.

His ribbons fluttered like three immortal dao coiling around the world, sealing everything within including Primal Yin Immortal Ghost.

The latter evaded, wanting to switch to another spot. Alas, the whole area was sealed so he needed to break the three dao first.

“Xian Chengtian!” Others recognized the ribbon-like dao and became shocked.

This overlord sealed their world with a single thought, clearly capable of deciding their fate.

“That’s Xian Chengtian!” Powerful cultivators followed the ribbons and saw Xian Chengtian stopping Primal Yin Immortal Ghost.

“The strongest beneath the immortal stage.” They couldn’t look away.
